Computed over the raw complete-case respondents (398 NA + 379 BG = 777) and matched as 14-dimensional multisets against the study's derived files (variables_NA_excloutliers.csv n=261 + variables_BG_excloutliers.csv n=245 = 506, which concatenate to the Data_Full.csv that data/Resistance.R reads): 0 of 506 derived response vectors unreproduced. Falsification: all 42 transpositions of two same-family items' frame pairs were re-run and the BEST rival leaves 197 of 506 unreproduced (a loss-partner-only swap leaves at least 288 of 506). So every item is separated from every other. Live-table link: irw_table_sets(per_item=TRUE) gives 14 items x 506 non-missing responses = 7,084 rows, matching the derived file row-for-row in count, with resp ranges 0-5 on all seven RC_ items and 0-3/0-4 on the AF_ items. What this does NOT establish: nothing about option_text<->resp, which is untested because option_text is blank by design (resp is a derived difference score with no administered anchors).
